generate_build_files_android: run generate_build_files.py with android flag to produce Android.bp and sources.mk build files
generate_build_files_bazel: run generate_build_files.py with bazel flag to produce BUILD.generated.bzl and BUILD.generated_tests.bzl files
generate_build_files_gn: run generate_build_files.py with gn flag to produce BUILD.generated.gni and BUILD.generated_tests.gni files
generate_build_files_gyp: run generate_build_files.py with gyp flag to produce boringssl.gypi with source file variables
generate_build_files_eureka: run generate_build_files.py with eureka flag to produce eureka.mk for the Eureka Trusty build system
